name: Circuit simulation
description: Draw a circuit as a schematic and simulate it on our own solver: DC operating point, transient and AC sweep, read with a meter, a scope and a plotter placed on nets. Part values are typed by you; no maker's models or Multisim files are read.
author: CadCraft
honesty: Our own solver (modified nodal analysis with Newton iteration) checked against closed forms; part values are the ones you type, not a maker's model. It reads no Multisim files and has no part library of real devices.
